name: Chipping Sparrow
desc: Chipping Sparrow (Spizella passerina): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4,028 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The chipping sparrow is a species of New World sparrow, a passerine bird in the family Passerellidae. It is widespread, fairly tame, and common across most of its North American range.
